source: Exact P65 IDB with direct caller and vtable instruction checks. Scope limited to legacy Application lifecycle and QJS. No runtime test.

application_lookup.nativeproxy_opaque: 0xCA32A2C validates class1 and returns object+40 AppEffectManager
application_lookup.effect_manager_application: AppEffectManager+108, assigned by 0xCA168B0 from framework current Application
application_lookup.primary_vtable: 0x3C3275E0, constructor write literal referenced at 0xC9FDCEC; two Itanium prefix words

qjs.free_cstring: 0xC6B9C48 decrements ptr-16 and frees string storage
qjs.is_function: 0xC6BC588 checks class13, class41 callable flag and class call slot
qjs.call: 0xC704988 normal-call wrapper, distinct from constructor paths
qjs.get_exception: 0xCA32A74 -> 0xC6BC560 reads and clears runtime exception slot

notes: legacy_application returns only after stock primary-vtable equality; no Application.runtime identity requirement during early bootstrap.
legacy_publish now uses the actual global object. All JSValue ownership conventions remain as in the first pass.
Unknown CoC event numbers remain zero; this pass did not assign or infer them.
SUPPORTED remains false. GAP, CoC, task plumbing, signatures and runtime tests are outside this scoped pass.
